resources.string: No saved servers. Enter an address above or tap + to add one.
Please enter the share path in the address bar above
Trash of the network share %s. Every device that uses this share sees it.

Searches the folders of your saved connections on this share for previews that are no longer needed (of deleted, renamed or changed files, or made by an older version of the app) and then asks whether to delete them. Previews of existing files stay. Your pictures and videos are not touched.
The share could not be read completely. Nothing was deleted.
%1$d unused preview file(s) found (%2$s). Delete them?

Create the previews of all pictures and videos in “%s” and its sub folders now? This can take a while and reads each file once over the network. Afterwards the previews are on the share and show up quickly, even on a slow connection.
Preparing the previews in the background…
The previews are already being prepared
Skipped because they took too long: %s
Outside the home network only with VPN
In the home Wi-Fi LiteGallery connects to the NAS directly. In any other Wi-Fi and on mobile data only once the VPN is on; otherwise the app asks for it as soon as you open a network connection.
Please enter the name of your home Wi-Fi
You are not in the home network “%1$s” but on mobile data. Switch on the VPN first.
You are in another Wi-Fi than “%1$s”. Switch on the VPN first.
Without the location permission LiteGallery cannot tell whether you are in the home network “%1$s”. Switch on the VPN or grant the permission.
With the location switched off LiteGallery cannot tell whether you are in the home network “%1$s”. Switch on the VPN or the location.
The name of the Wi-Fi cannot be read right now, so it is unclear whether you are in the home network “%1$s”. Switch on the VPN first.
As soon as that is done, it goes on by itself.

Android tells the name of the connected Wi-Fi only to apps with the location permission. LiteGallery uses it only to recognize your home Wi-Fi and does not determine your location. Please choose “Precise” and “While using the app”.
Without the “Precise location” permission LiteGallery cannot recognize your home Wi-Fi. You can grant it later in the app settings.
Location is switched off, so Android does not tell the name of the Wi-Fi.
No Wi-Fi connected right now (or Android does not tell its name).
Encrypts everything between phone and NAS, also in the home network. The NAS has to allow SMB3. Guest connections cannot be encrypted. Large transfers may get a little slower.
The NAS does not offer an encrypted transfer (SMB3). Allow SMB3 in the settings of the NAS or switch off the encryption under “Home network and security”.
LiteGallery remembers your NAS when you first log in. If another device answers at its address later, the app sends no login there.
Another device than your NAS answered at %1$s. To be safe, no login was sent.
If you replaced, reset or renamed the NAS, you can accept the new device. Otherwise please cancel, above all in a foreign network.
Connection saved, but the password could not be encrypted on this device and was therefore not saved.
